channel.title: Haste Updates
channel.description: Most recent updates for Haste for Apple Silicon.

item.title: Haste 1.0.1
item.description:
Haste 1.0.1 Update

  • Standard macOS app data location (~/Library/Application Support/Haste), opening empty when no data exists.
  • Refreshed app icon: gold coin on an emerald green field with stamped H monogram.
  • Unified top-level View menu combining all navigation and view options.

item.title: Haste 1.0.0
item.description:
Haste 1.0.0 Initial Release

  • Native Apple Silicon implementation and historical data format suite.
  • Full checkbook register, account reconciliation, planning & budgets, and check writing.
  • Integrated Sparkle automatic updates.
